ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) pixels; approximately 15% high-intensity mottling distributed over an 85% low-intensity background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Light-grey diffuse mottling concentrated along the trailing margins of both lobes. Distinct cluster of high-contrast white circular spots located in the distal upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 78 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 20% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern along the entire continuous boundary; right lobe exhibits smaller, more frequent peaks, while the left lobe shows broader, more irregular undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edge (bottom in view) tapering towards sharp, slightly up-swept lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of at least 6-8 distinct circular white rings/spots (barnacle scars) localized on the distal half of the right lobe; sparse similar markings on the distal left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One faint dark vertical linear disruption visible on the proximal-medial surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Brownish stalked biological attachments (likely Xenobalanus globicipitis) visible on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific grouping of 'doughnut-shaped' white rings on the right lobe which provide a unique spatial fingerprint.
